limitations: Two packets are sisters from one dominant pedigree, not independent families.
Cell/fly models use overexpression; WT itself causes dose-relatedtoxicity. Shorttermknockdown is not exclusionofevery possibleLOF contribution.
Cytoplasmiclocalization/rescue evidence is distinct from speculative long-term RNPaggregatepathology.
SupplementTable1 gives alternateB1 c1004delA whereas clinicalnote c1002delA; packetA2c966 unaffected. Lastvariant genomicposition appearsmissingdigit.
SourceData sheetFigure5 labels deletion323–342 whereas main says323–341; sheetS5panel labels shifted; Fig7G G331Efs hasonly2replicates.
Reportingform says nodataexcluded, but main reports nonexpressingflylines notused; blinding absent.
